name: Hotel Goldener Hirsch Salzburg
positioning: Hotel Goldener Hirsch, a Luxury Collection Hotel: a traditionally furnished inn dating to the 15th century on the Getreidegasse in Salzburg's medieval Old Town
best_for: Travelers coming for the Salzburg Festival and classical music
Couples and families who want to explore the Old Town on foot

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Salzburg's medieval Old Town, surrounded by shops displaying wrought iron guild signs.
The historic Getreidegasse, a thoroughfare since Roman times, lies just outside the hotel.
Mozart's birthplace is just a few steps from the hotel.
The Festival Hall is just across the street from the hotel.
Salzburg's Old Town was named a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1997.
The rooms are elegant and traditionally furnished.
Restaurant Herzl serves Austrian cuisine in a modern yet cozy atmosphere.
The hotel regularly hosts special culinary events at Restaurant Herzl and Bar Goldener Hirsch.
The hotel is child-friendly and welcomes guests of all ages.
Haus der Natur, a museum with exhibitions, a zoo area and science stations, is a stone's throw from the hotel.
The Toy Museum, known for its collection of antique toys, is just around the corner from the hotel.

highlights.text: When the Salzburg Festival took place for the first time in 1920, the hotel was the festival's first host.
The inn first welcomed guests in the 15th century.
The interiors feature vaulted ceilings, antique farmers' furniture and deer and stag heads, and staff wear lederhosen and dirndls.
Hohensalzburg Fortress, Europe's largest castle complex, can be reached on foot from the hotel in ten minutes.

considerations.text: Driving can be a hassle because of pedestrian-only areas and confusing road signs; Conde Nast Traveler suggests taking the train from Vienna or Munich.
The Salzburg Festival weeks are a busy time at the hotel every year.
WhataHotel notes that the historic building has limited modern amenities such as fitness facilities.
